title: Alliances Budget Support - Supervising Associate
description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Alliances Budget Support - Supervising Associate | ES Finance Our purpose, at EY, is building a better working world. The Alliances Shared Services Bureau within EY GDS is a dynamic and cross-functional business unit spanning multiple locations across India in addition to Philippines and Argentina. We provide operational excellence through methodologies and tools to build sustainable processes and practices, powering the Global Alliances and Ecosystem Relationships enablement engine. Our work aims to help reinforce our purpose of building a better working world for our people, our customers, and communities. Role summary The GDS Alliances Finance Budget Supervisor will function out of the ES Finance service function and will be responsible for providing ongoing Finance operations support to the Global Alliance Ecosystem Finance and working closely with GDS Alliances Finance Budget Manager, as part of the broader global Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The incumbent will be responsible for facilitating financial transactions, project management, budget management support, and other operational activities as per the agreed scope of support, using EY s global finance systems and tools. Description Technical expertise: Budgets Planning: Support Annual financial planning - costs, expenses and yearly forecasts. Analyse actuals against the budget details and manage budget reallocations as needed. Summarise data weekly for the budget dashboards and process reclass entries wherever required. Manage year-end accruals to ensure effective utilization of available budget through recording and submitting to Finance accrual entries for expenses incurred through the year that are not processed during the same year. Engagement Code management: Ensure proper use of travel expenses and accurate code mapping across Global and Americas sponsoring entities. Manage cost movements across codes throughout the year. Annual fee: Track manage annual alliance fee records and process journal entries for codes received. Manage monthly recurring entries and year end accruals. GDS budget Analysis / updates: Manage and update GDS headcount file with latest rates, headcount status, new roles and hiring/exit status. Reconcile general chargeback code to regularly assess and report available balance for GDS cost management. Provide details to stakeholders on required fees to manage GDS costs. Perform headcount analysis and savings through cost arbitrage. Connect with stakeholders as required to understand the budget usage, future expected costs and accruals. Manage GDS invoice records, billing inventory, and assist in periodic invoicing activities. Review reconcile invoices and highlight any discrepancies in the GDS invoices. Reporting: Weekly budget to actuals for the charge codes assigned. Reporting monthly financials and other reports highlighting key performance parameters. Assist in monitoring and tracking the financial results against operational and strategic objectives as well as historical performance.Engage with the various alliance stakeholders regularly to provide custom reports and track upcoming anticipated costs and status against available budget. Operations: Provide Operational support/cost improvement studies to enable effective management to improve operations and increase the efficiency of resources/processes. Provide headcount reports to manage distribution lists on a monthly basis. Share invoices with the processing team and track payment status on a weekly basis. Coordinate with functional teams for collecting data. Investments: Track all GTM invoices, compare the budget allocation, analyse the available budget, send details to stakeholders for required approvals and connect weekly with GTM team. Connect with GDS team on the open items, provide support on the invoicing process, offer any other finance support on the new programs / activities. Reconcile and summarise investment data for quarterly reporting and dashboard. Adhoc Analysis / Reports: Ad-hoc reporting/operations/admin support for initiatives/ projects as required. Study, analyse, and understand business requirements in the context of preparing executive summaries, reports, key takeaways, and visualizations.. Automation of reports wherever possible and provide inputs for process improvement, building efficiencies, and standardization Process Improvement and Standardization: Define processes and lead/support the design of processes and roles leveraging best-in-class practices and enabling technologies, to ensure optimum and consistent performance. Develop and maintain detailed documentation around the processes and ongoing transactions. Stakeholder management and project handling: Understand stakeholder requirements based on business context. Strong operational acumen to create impactful relationships with Senior leadership. Focus on client and effectively use consultative approaches for stakeholder management. Capability to engage multiple stakeholders by quickly understanding the objectives. Communicate critical business indicators with in-depth reports and dashboards. Enhance and maintain support systems and communication channels. Move quickly toward client programs or initiatives and exercise delivery mode in a short span. Help increase impact of the outlined strategies and run seamless day-to-day operations. Read, understand, and sanitize the data, build reports, and provide insights. Soft skills: Capability to quickly understand the needs of the business and align with changing customer expectations. Ability to work under minimal supervision. Skilled at taking ownership and driving projects end-to-end. Self-motivated to learn new tools and technology. Strong inclination toward upskilling Ability to articulate concisely and think out-of-the-box. Ability to focus on solutions in case of ambiguity and overcome the problem. Display a positive attitude with the capability to work under pressure. Leadership and people management: High-performing team player accustomed to an agile, fast-paced environment. Displays assertiveness - however, should also be a good listener and consensus builder with executive level stakeholders. Effective in time management and project prioritization Shows high degree of professionalism and integrity. Uses outstanding speaking and writing skills to enhance understanding and encourage collaboration. Collaborative mindset with ability to identify risk or opportunity areas. Ability to think ahead of the curve and forecast outcomes to suggest appropriate solutions. Academics Graduate or post-graduate degree in commerce/finance. Job qualification 8+ years of hands-on experience in a fast-paced global environment, should be able to perform highly complex transactions in person (not by delegating) Advanced knowledge of the principles of accounting. Experience working as an accountant is preferred, alternatively experience in GL domain in BPO FA. Exposure to budget preparation and maintenance Proficient in MS Excel, exposure to MS Access and Power Bi would be an added advantage. Should be comfortable with working on large spreadsheets with multiple pages and with extensive data, should have a good eye for detail. Experience in working with Finance systems, preferably in an SAP environment. Should have good English speaking and writing skills, should be an effective communicator. Should be a fast learner and should be quick to pick up concepts and requirements. Should be able to take the lead, work independently and ensure that work is properly organized, and delivered in a timely manner, with high accuracy and quality. Experience of interacting with geographically dispersed professionals strongly preferred. Reporting experience, knowledge of standard metrics and key performance indicators Understanding of business research or data interpretation and analysis concepts Understanding of Project Management concepts and experience working on non-IT projects Professional services industry experience, or internal or external client-serving experience preferred. Interview rounds and types. HR screening Technical Assessment, Hiring Manager interaction Onshore stakeholder interaction EY | Building a better working world

title: Process Transformation & Technology Specialist - FAPS
description:
Process Transformation & Technology Specialist - Finance and Procurement Business Operations- Transformation 
 Function 
Finance & Procurement Business Operations 
 Scope 
Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Intercompany, Master Data Management, Procurement Operations and Service desk Transformation.

 Position Summary 
Process Transformation & Technology Specialist plays a critical role in driving operational excellence and transformation initiatives across global Finance and Procurement functions. The role is responsible for identifying, designing, and implementing process improvements, automation solutions, and operating model enhancements that improve efficiency, controls, stakeholder experience, and business outcomes.
Working across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany, Master Data, and Procurement processes, this position partners closely with Finance and Procurement Operations, Shared Services, Controllership, Business Teams, and Digital Technology organizations to translate strategic priorities into scalable, measurable solutions.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Transformation & Process Excellence 
 Lead and deliver transformation initiatives across AP, AR, Intercompany, Master Data, and Procurement in alignment with the broader Finance Transformation roadmap. Analyze current-state processes, identify root causes and inefficiencies, and design future-state solutions that improve service delivery, controls, compliance, and efficiency. Drive process standardization, simplification, and harmonization across regions while balancing local regulatory and business requirements. Develop business cases, process maps, operating procedures, requirements documentation, test scenarios, and deployment plans. Identify opportunities to improve transaction quality, cycle times, working capital performance, and overall process effectiveness. Support implementation activities including user acceptance testing, defect resolution, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization. 
 Digital Transformation & Automation 
 Partner with technology teams and process owners to evaluate, prioritize, and deploy automation and workflow solutions. Leverage process mining, process intelligence, and analytics capabilities to identify improvement opportunities and measure outcomes. Support implementation of digital technologies including SAP Signavio, SAP Build Process Automation, Microsoft Power Platform, AI-enabled tools, and workflow technologies. Drive adoption of analytics and reporting solutions using Power BI, Databricks, and related platforms. Explore and implement practical AI and machine learning use cases to improve knowledge management, decision support, transaction processing, and operational efficiency. Ensure automation solutions incorporate appropriate governance, controls, auditability, data quality standards, and ownership frameworks. 
 Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership 
 Facilitate workshops, process reviews, design sessions, and governance forums with key stakeholders. Build alignment across Finance, Procurement, Shared Services, Technology, and Business teams to support successful transformation outcomes. Develop communication plans, training materials, operating procedures, and change management strategies. Manage risks, dependencies, and escalations while ensuring stakeholder engagement and adoption. Promote a culture of continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, and best-practice methodologies. 
 Governance, Controls & Performance Management 
 Maintain project governance artifacts including project plans, risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, dependency logs, and benefits realization frameworks. Provide regular executive-level reporting on delivery progress, milestones, risks, adoption, and value realization. Ensure solutions remain compliant with finance policies, internal controls, audit requirements, regulatory obligations, and governance standards. Monitor post-implementation performance and drive corrective actions when expected outcomes are not achieved. Contribute to the development of transformation playbooks, methodologies, standards, and reusable assets. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline. MBA, Master's degree, PGDBA, or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred. Lean Six Sigma, PMP, Agile, Change Management, or other transformation certifications preferred. 
 Professional Experience 
 8+ years of experience in Finance Operations, Shared Services, Global Business Services (GBS), Procurement Operations, or Management Consulting. Minimum 3 years of experience leading or supporting finance transformation, process improvement, automation, or operating model initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects across multiple business units, regions, or stakeholder groups. Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany Accounting, Master Data, and Procurement processes. Experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments. Practical experience in process mapping, business requirements definition, operating model design, and implementation support. Experience working with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Excel, Databricks, or equivalent platforms. Automotive, manufacturing, or OEM industry experience strongly preferred. 
 Core Competencies 
 Business Process Expertise 
 Strong understanding of end-to-end AP, AR, Intercompany, Procurement, and Master Data processes. Knowledge of operational KPIs, service levels, controls, compliance requirements, and financial performance drivers. Transformation & Continuous Improvement 
 Proven ability to convert business challenges into scalable process, technology, and operating model solutions. Expertise in process reengineering, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies. Data & Analytics 
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and measure business outcomes. Ability to develop insights that drive operational improvements and decision-making. Relationship Management 
 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without direct authority. Excellent communication and presentation capabilities across operational and leadership audiences. Governance & Controls 
 Understanding of internal controls, audit frameworks, risk management, segregation of duties, and compliance requirements. Ability to ensure transformation initiatives balance efficiency gains with a strong control environment. 
 Success Measures 
 Success in this role will be measured through: 
 Successful delivery of transformation initiatives within agreed scope, timeline, and budget. Improvements in process efficiency, automation adoption, cycle times, and service quality. Increased straight-through processing and reduction of manual effort, exceptions, and rework. Improvements in working capital metrics including invoice cycle times, DSO, aging, unapplied cash, and intercompany reconciliation performance. Improved master data quality, governance adherence, and turnaround times. Sustainable governance, controls compliance, and audit readiness. 
 Preferred Technology Landscape 
 SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC SAP Signavio (Process Mining, Process Insights, Process Modeling) SAP Build Process Automation (SAP BTP) SAP MDG and SAP GRC SAP Joule / SAP Business AI Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio Databricks KNIME Analytics Platform OpenText Workflow Solutions Intercompany Accounting Systems (IAS) SharePoint and Enterprise Collaboration Platforms

title: Transportation Load Planner
description:
Job Overview The Transportation Load Planner is responsible for planning, scheduling, and releasing domestic and international customer and intercompany shipments in a manner that maximizes weight and volume per load, minimizes freight costs, and ensures customer requested dates are met or exceeded. This role works closely with customer service, warehouse operations, carriers, freight forwarders, and other business partners to support the efficient movement of goods throughout the supply chain. A Day In The Life - Plan, schedule, and release domestic / international / intercompany shipments to support customer requirements and business objectives. 
 - Utilize SAP, MercuryGate TMS, and other business systems to plan, release, monitor, and manage shipments. 
 - Coordinate daily shipment activity with warehouse operations to maintain a balanced workload. 
 - Work closely with Customer Service to support customer requirements, prioritize urgent requests, and resolve shipment-related issues. 
 - Select the appropriate carrier, transportation mode, and routing option in accordance with Hubbells routing guidelines and customer requirements 
 - Communicate with carriers, freight forwarders, brokers, and third-party logistics providers to ensure shipments are planned and customer expectations are met. 
 - Utilize customer routing portals to obtain routing instructions, schedule shipments, and ensure compliance with customer transportation requirements. 
 - Review materials and shipment requirements to optimize freight capacity. 
 - Provide clear shipment notes and instructions to warehouse personnel and transportation partners to ensure customer requirements are understood. 
 - Ensure shipment documentation requirements are properly addressed. 
 - Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying operational issues and opportunities to improve service, efficiency, and overall performance. 
 - Provide carrier freight quotes for customer shipment requests. 
 - Support Return Material Authorization (RMA) processes 
 - Provide back-up coverage for team members as needed. 
 - Provide on-call support after hours during emergencies/severe weather conditions. 
 - Other duties as assigned by the Transportation Management Systems Manager. What will help you thrive in this role - Bachelor s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Business, or related field preferred. 
 - Experience in transportation, logistics, distribution, warehouse operations, shipping, customer service, or other supply chain-related functions preferred. 
 - Experience working with carriers, freight forwarders, third-party logistics providers, or transportation service providers is a plus. 
 - SAP experience preferred; Warehouse Management experience is a plus but not required. 
 - Experience using transportation management systems (TMS) preferred; MercuryGate experience is a plus but not required. 
 - Experience using customer routing portals; a plus but not required. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills. 
 - Good verbal and written communication skills. 
 - Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Teams, and Excel. 
 - Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to multi-task. 
 - Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a team. 
 - Adaptability and willingness to learn in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 
 - Strong teamwork skills and a customer-focused mindset. Hubbell Incorporated Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. Functional areas include Engineering, Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Legal, IT, Human Resources, Payroll, Environmental Health Safety, and Compliance. title: Technical Delivery Coordinator
description:
Role Positioning The Technical Delivery Coordinator provides delivery operations and coordination support for technology programs and initiatives. The role maintains delivery controls, schedules, dependencies, action plans, readiness activities, reporting, and project records to provide accurate and timely visibility into delivery progress. By proactively tracking commitments, monitoring dependencies, coordinating follow-up actions, and escalating emerging concerns, the Technical Delivery Coordinator enables the Program Manager to focus on delivery leadership, stakeholder engagement, governance, risk management, and strategic decision-making. This position serves as the central coordination point for delivery administration and operational execution support but is not accountable for program outcomes, scope decisions, budget authority, resource allocation, delivery commitments, vendor negotiations, or strategic technology decisions. The role is expected to identify potential issues early, ensure information remains accurate and current, and provide the structured follow-through necessary to support predictable and successful technology delivery. Position Summary The Technical Delivery Coordinator is a detail-oriented delivery support professional responsible for maintaining project plans, timelines, trackers, documentation, meeting follow-up, and day-to-day delivery controls across technology initiatives. The coordinator works under the direction of the Program Manager and partners with development, QA, business, operations, vendors, and other assigned resources to ensure commitments are documented, monitored, and followed through to completion. Operating Model The Technical Delivery Coordinator serves as the operational delivery support partner to the Program Manager. The coordinator maintains delivery controls, follow-through, project documentation, reporting, and readiness activities while the Program Manager retains accountability for scope, priorities, budget, resource allocation, stakeholder management, and program outcomes. Primary Outcomes Project plans and milestone dates are current, accurate, and supported by named owners and dependencies. Upcoming deliverables, overdue actions, blockers, and decisions are visible before they become missed commitments. Meeting actions, requirements questions, risks, and issues are documented and followed through to closure. Teams receive timely reminders, clear assignments, and organized documentation needed to execute the work. The Program Manager receives concise, decision-ready updates and can focus on higher-priority client, vendor, business, and delivery escalations. Core Responsibilities Project Planning and Schedule Maintenance Create and maintain project plans, implementation timelines, milestone schedules, workback plans, and task trackers using approved templates and tools.

 Break approved deliverables into trackable activities with owners, target dates, dependencies, status, and completion evidence. Collect estimates and sequencing information from assigned team members and update the plan based on direction from the Program Manager or technical lead. Monitor planned versus actual dates and identify tasks that are late, at risk, missing an owner, or dependent on unresolved work. Maintain near-term look-ahead views for upcoming deadlines, testing windows, releases, client commitments, and vendor deliverables. Prepare proposed schedule updates when dates shift, clearly showing the reason, affected milestones, downstream impact, and required decision. Delivery Tracking and Follow-Through Obtain regular status updates from task owners and keep project records current without waiting for the Program Manager to request each update. Follow up on open tasks, overdue actions, unanswered questions, approvals, test results, documentation, and delivery commitments. Maintain action, decision, risk, issue, assumption, dependency, and change logs as required for each initiative. Confirm that completed items have the expected documentation or evidence before marking them complete. Track cross-team handoffs and verify that receiving teams have the information, access, files, environments, or approvals needed to begin their work. Raise concerns promptly when updates are not received, dates are likely to be missed, requirements are incomplete, or ownership is unclear. Risk, Issue, and Dependency Coordination Identify and document delivery risks, blockers, resource conflicts, unresolved dependencies, environment constraints, and missing decisions. Capture the issue, business or delivery impact, owner, target date, mitigation action, and escalation need in plain language. Follow up with owners on mitigation actions and bring overdue or ineffective actions to the Program Manager for direction. Prepare concise escalation summaries that state what happened, what is affected, what has been attempted, available options, and the decision needed. Monitor dependencies across business, development, QA, operations, vendors, and client activities and flag sequencing conflicts early. Meeting and Communication Support Prepare agendas, status materials, open-item lists, and decision questions for project meetings. Attend assigned meetings, document decisions and action items, and distribute clear notes with owners and dates. Maintain recurring meeting cadence, cancel unnecessary meetings with approval, and ensure unresolved items are carried forward. Draft routine project communications, reminders, status updates, and follow-up messages for Program Manager review when required. Organize project information so stakeholders can quickly understand current status, next steps, open risks, and items requiring their input. Requirements, Tickets, and Documentation Readiness Review project requests and work items for required information, including objective, scope, business need, owner, acceptance criteria, dependencies, target date, and supporting documentation. Identify incomplete, conflicting, or unclear information and route questions to the appropriate business or technical owner before work is scheduled. Coordinate the movement of approved work through intake, planning, development, testing, release, and closure stages based on the established process. Maintain organized project folders, meeting notes, requirements, approvals, test evidence, release records, and decision history. Ensure project trackers, tickets, and status reports use consistent terminology and reflect the same dates, owners, and current status. Testing, Release, and Implementation Coordination 
 FIMC Job Description | Technical Delivery Coordinator | Page 3 
 Coordinate test schedules, tester assignments, environment readiness, defect follow-up, retesting dates, and sign-off tracking under the direction of the Program Manager and QA lead. Maintain readiness checklists for requirements, development completion, testing, approvals, communications, implementation, rollback, and post-release validation. Confirm that required participants understand their assigned implementation steps and timing before a release or launch. Track implementation actions and post-production follow-up, including stabilization items, defects, documentation, and handoff to support. Escalate missed readiness criteria or unresolved defects before planned releases. Vendor and Cross-Functional Coordination Track vendor deliverables, due dates, open questions, requested documentation, testing dependencies, and follow-up actions. Coordinate routine information exchange among business teams, technology teams, QA, operations, and vendors. Maintain a record of vendor commitments and identify conflicts between vendor dates and internal delivery plans. Prepare supporting information for vendor or client discussions while the Program Manager retains ownership of sensitive negotiations, escalations, and relationship decisions. Route requests and issues to the correct owner and verify that responses are received and recorded. Status Reporting and Project Administration Prepare weekly status reports and dashboards showing schedule health, completed work, upcoming milestones, overdue items, risks, issues, decisions, and support needed. Validate status information against source trackers and task-owner updates before distribution. Maintain project calendars, contact lists, distribution lists, recurring reminders, and standard templates. Assist with tracking project hours, purchase requests, invoices, budget updates, or vendor records when assigned; escalate discrepancies for review. Support project closeout by confirming deliverables, approvals, documentation, lessons learned, and remaining operational actions are recorded. Decision Authority and Escalation Boundaries

title: BC - SC and O - O and G Upstream Ops - Manager
description:
Manager Subsurface (O&G Upstream) Job Summary Upstream Operations Subject Matter Expert (SME) embedded within a digital / AI use case delivery squad, acting as the functional bridge between upstream operations stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams (product, data science, data engineering, architecture). The role is non-coding and focuses on shaping, translating, validating, and governing upstream operations analytics / AI solutions to improve asset profitability, production efficiency, and recovery. Operating Model & Reporting Workstream leadership role within an Agile / product-style delivery environment; responsible for end-to-end functional success of upstream operations use cases from discovery to deployment. Interfaces with upstream business teams and technical delivery teams (product managers, data scientists, data engineers, solution architects). Reports into Consulting Delivery Leadership and partners closely with MENA stakeholders on SC&O / Digital Ops priorities. Key Responsibilities Upstream Operations Use Case Discovery & Functional Support Lead discovery sessions with upstream operations stakeholders to capture decision workflows, operational pain points, constraints, and success criteria Own the creation of structured documentation: use case descriptions, functional requirements, assumptions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder-ready narratives. Define and align upstream operations transformation roadmaps to improve asset profitability, production efficiency, and recovery. Digital / AI Use Case Delivery Support (Non-Coding) Translate upstream operations requirements into technical inputs for delivery teams (features, inputs, operational constraints, data definitions/classifications), ensuring feasibility and traceability. Support delivery of upstream operations digital solutions by helping define and validate data and workflow needs, including combining inputs from field planning, operations, and finance for performance optimization Validate analytics outputs, dashboards, and insights against operational realism and operating philosophies; drive iterative improvements with product/data teams. Stakeholder Management & Client-Facing Delivery Act as a trusted interface between upstream operations stakeholders and technical delivery teams; sustain credibility through practical workflow understanding. Lead structured feedback cycles (including pilots and phased rollouts) and convert feedback into clear requirements/backlog items. Lead cross-functional engagement and interviews across relevant upstream stakeholders as needed for platform delivery (e.g., field operations interfaces such as drilling/completions/facilities, HSE & emissions, finance/accounting, data infrastructure). Governance, Quality & Assurance Support definition of data quality standards, operational assumptions, and validation checkpoints for upstream operations datasets and model outputs. Ensure solutions align with established practices and contribute to documentation, playbooks, and governance artifacts for deployed use cases. Drive UAT planning and execution from a functional lens; confirm outputs are credible and usable for operations decision-making. Required Experience & Qualifications 810 years of upstream Oil & Gas experience with strong upstream operations / field operations depth. Practical experience articulating upstream operations workflows in practice, including operational constraints and data quality considerations. Strong communication and structured documentation skills; ability to translate operations concepts clearly to non-engineers and technical teams. Demonstrated cross-functional delivery experience spanning operations / engineering / digital teams in Agile delivery environments. Fluency in English (mandatory). Engineering Degree in Chemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Petroleum disciplines MBA Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, digital transformation, optimization, or surveillance initiatives in upstream contexts. Familiarity with upstream operations / production data sources and reporting environments used for operational performance tracking. Arabic language capability (optional).
